inventory_summary: Resolved model at 539d9a81: 180 base runs (31 rooms + 4 stair-landing runs; kinds trim, resilient_base), 46 door casings on 28 doors, 39 window stools (stool top = frame sill rail top, checked), skirts, TrimStandard.stocks, jamb stock depths, PaintStandard trim/door paint rows. Sheets opened: A-002 (viewed), A-516 (viewed), A-603 (viewed), A-601/A-601.1 (text, jamb column vs model checked), A-517..A-530 (text layer searched; A-525..A-527 plant-room notes read). Products web-checked: FJ pine 1x4 0.719", MDF 11/16" (round 1 HD), PVC 3/4", prehung FJ jamb 11/16", rubber base 4"/1/8" (retailer listings only). NOT examined: window stool/returns geometry beyond the top-height probe (O1/O4), exterior-door casing, the drywall return at uncased faces (drywall owner), Johnsonite manufacturer data sheet (retailer pages only), Masonite/JELD-WEN unit data (no unit chosen), A-518..A-524, A-528..A-530 visually (text layer only).
verified_clean: Base z0 = the room's finished floor in all 31 rooms (0.000") on LVP, oak, carpet, tile, sheet vinyl, concrete; landing base at 61.26" on the landing finish (ST-M2S).
Base thickness follows stock: pine 23/32, pvc 3/4, locust 3/4, rubber 1/8 (interior_trim_base._runs thickness_for).
Casing head bottom = RO head - 13/16"; 0.306" above the leaf top and 3/16" above the jamb head face on every swing door (jamb head 2.0894 m vs casing 2.0942 m on D-M-BED).
Casing legs start at the finished floor of their own room; carpet-side heads 1/4" higher AFF than hall-side, consistent with the Z-bar rule.

Trim paint LF ties to the resolved model: baseboard 518.88 billed vs 518.85 (pine 442.15 + pvc 76.70), door casing 706.91 vs 706.91 (mdf 623.99 + pvc 82.92); oiled hardwood (locust, cedar, cherry, oak) and rubber base excluded.
A-601 Jamb column matches the model: 4 9/16 / 6 9/16 stock, D-B-CLOSET 6 1/8" rip, D-S-SUITE 7" and D-S-PLANT 7 5/16" extensions, D-B-SAUNA 9 1/4" flat cedar.
ST-M2S skirt: 4 blanks, longest 103.45", 10' stock (4 boards).
Mudroom base/shiplap: shiplap band starts at the base top (4.526"), PVC base 3/4" flush with the 3/4" shiplap; no base offset.
A-603 Base/Walls populated for all 36 rooms; excluded rooms (furnace, ESS, workshop, gym, garage, unfinished attic) show em-dash, as A-002 says.
Casing/base stock sizes: FJ pine 23/32 (HD 0.719", Lowe's 23/32"), PVC 3/4, MDF 11/16 (round-1 HD 0.669" listing).

findings.title: Sheet-vinyl rooms: base modelled and printed 3 1/2" tall; the specified product is a 4" Johnsonite rubber cove base (A-525..A-527 say 4")

evidence.measured: 4 rooms, 25 resilient_base runs, 118.0 LF: height_m = 3.5" (TrimStandard.base_height, taken for every base kind), thickness 1/8", z0 = finished floor (0.0" off, correct). A-603 prints 'catlin-vinyl-gatsby 3.5"'; A-525/526/527 notes print 'Floor: SurePly + seamless sheet; 4" rubber base, silicone toe'. Both material sources say '4" Johnsonite rubber cove base'.
evidence.expected: Base height 4" for the rubber cove (Johnsonite/Tarkett rubber base ships in 2.5", 4", 6" heights at 1/8" gauge); A-603 and A-525..527 agree. LF billing is unaffected, only the drawn height and the printed 3.5".
evidence.method: m.base_runs filtered kind=='resilient_base': {height_m*39.37, thickness_m*39.37}; pdftotext -f 152 -l 152 and -f 76 -l 78 -layout permit_set_full.pdf. Probe: scratchpad O2/p1.py

findings.source: https://www.floorcity.com/products/johnsonite-129-silk-rubber-wall-base-4-inch-height (retailer listing: 4" height, 1/8" gauge); materials_flooring.py source strings. Not from Tarkett's own data sheet.
findings.proposed_fix: Give resilient_base its own height (Material.base_height or a TrimStandard per-kind height) = 4"; the check/clearance readers of base_height_m (base breaks at obstacles, _obstacles top) follow.

findings.title: A-603 names the floor sheet as the base stock in 4 rooms; A-002 interior-trim block says '+6' wet rooms take PVC base and never mentions the rubber cove base

evidence.measured: A-002 (06 22 00): 'RM-M-BATH1, RM-M-BATH2 +6: base pvc-trim 3/4", bought; base and casing flush.' The RoomTrim lists 8 rooms; 3 of them (RM-B-BATH, RM-A-STUBATH, RM-S-PLANT) have no PVC base (vinyl floors' base_detail=resilient_base) and RM-A-STUDIO is not named at all. A-603 Base column reads 'catlin-vinyl-gatsby 3.5"' / 'catlin-plant-vinyl-raised 3.5"' (the sheet-goods tags). Only 5 rooms have pvc-trim base.
evidence.expected: A-002: one line for the resilient base (4" rubber cove, silicone toe, in RM-A-STUDIO, RM-A-STUBATH, RM-B-BATH, RM-S-PLANT) and the PVC-base list limited to the 5 tile/LVP baths; A-603 prints the base product ('rubber cove 4"'), not the floor material tag.
evidence.method: pdftotext -f 28 -l 28 -layout permit_set_full.pdf; python: {b.room: b.material_ref for b in m.base_runs if b.kind=='resilient_base'}. Probe O2/p1.py

findings.proposed_fix: Generate the A-002 room list from the resolved base runs (kind and material) instead of the authored RoomTrim rooms; schedule Base column from the base product.

findings.title: Casing reveal assumes a 3/4" jamb; stock prehung FJ pine jambs are 11/16"

evidence.measured: jamb_thickness_m = 0.01905 (3/4") and jamb_allowance 1" = '3/4" jamb + 1/4" shim'; casing inner edge 13/16" inside the RO, reveal printed on A-002 as 3/16". Door types name no maker ('1 3/8in hollow-core molded prehung').
evidence.expected: Primed FJ pine 4-9/16" jambs are 11/16" (0.687" actual at Lowe's): jamb face 15/16" in, reveal 1/8" (inside the 1/8-1/4" norm). A 5/4 or 3/4" jamb is the exception. Unit maker unchosen, so low confidence.
evidence.method: O2/p2.py (CasedDoorSpec.jamb_thickness_m); web: HD/Lowe's 11/16 x 4-9/16 jamb listings

findings.proposed_fix: State 'reveal 1/8"-3/16" to the stock jamb' on A-002 or set the default jamb to 11/16" once a unit is chosen.

findings.title: Door-leaf paint (PT-4) omits the jamb inner faces: area is a projection on the wall plane, so a jamb counts as its 3/4" edge, not its 4 1/2"-7" depth

evidence.measured: 28 doors, 1,001.3 sf billed. Jamb inner faces (jamb_depth x (2 x RO height + width)) = about 195 sf, 19% of the bill, not in the area; the 121.8 LF painted pine jamb extensions and 14.1 LF rip are not in trim LF either. Trim LF does tie out: base 442.15 pine + 76.70 pvc = 518.85 LF vs billed 518.88; casing 623.99 mdf + 82.92 pvc = 706.91 LF vs billed 706.91.
evidence.expected: Painted jamb faces billed (door_leaf_paint_rows adds jamb_depth_m x jamb length, or LF x depth) for non-factory-finished interior doors.
evidence.method: O2/p11.py: sum 2*door_face_area_m2 per door vs sizing.jamb_depth_m*(2*height+width); O2/p12.py for LF tie-out

findings.proposed_fix: Add the jamb inner faces to door_leaf_paint_rows.
